subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value:
SECOND PASS OVER THE MIXED PERMUTE+FORM+RECOLOR CLASS, WITH THE THREE METHOD FIXES THAT MADE IT PAY. Parent: claim.HV_single-region-permute-plus-recolor-census.20260901.v1, whose filter is CORRECT and is not weakened here; this record supplies a canary discipline, an automated steps 4-5, and one trap that will bite the next lane. RESULT over the same image: 39 functions pass screens 1-3 against current objects (HV counted 29), and SEVEN functions were driven to real 0 this pass - HV's three named near-misses dcsSampleAllocUpload, MemCardCreateGaunt and do_camera, plus four HV's pass never nominated: ProcessCritter, calc_wizard_pos, next_boss_hint and next_legend_hint. Project matched 62.94% -> 63.35%, functions 2667 -> 2674.

FIX 1, THE FREE CANARY, and the reason to scan raw bodies even when you do not need to. The census must read OUR RAW compiler output (build/GUNE5D/src/**/.postprocess/body, falling back to the plain object) so postprocessed bytes cannot flatter the count - HV says this already, for that reason. The under-used consequence is that every ALREADY-SHIPPED webfrank rule is still visible as a residual in that view, so the shipped rule list IS a known-positive canary set, free and exact, requiring no fixture. This pass declared the scan trustworthy only after all ELEVEN shipped rules in the population came back (memCardErrorPrompt, camera_init_for_gamemode, sysPollResetButton, init_game_cam, pbObjTexSub, getNewPosRectShare, do_exit, fn_8005FB48 and this lane's own three). Run the canary check BEFORE reading any result: a scanner without one lies, and this class has already produced one silent-scanner incident.

FIX 2, THE IDENTITY-ORDER TRAP, which is new and costs a wrong rule if missed. An automated order search returns the IDENTITY permutation whenever the function needs no reorder at all, because the identity trivially satisfies every dependence check and every relocation binding. ProcessCritter came back exactly that way: search reported CLOSES with order [0,1,2]. Shipping it would have pinned a permutation region hash for a mechanism that does not exist and would have described a pure form+recolor residual as a schedule one in the rule's own prose - the thing a reviewer most relies on. TREAT AN IDENTITY ORDER AS A SIGNAL TO DROP THE PERMUTATION STAGE, not as a closure. ProcessCritter was re-derived as equivalent_copy_form + copy_register_fields alone and closes identically.

FIX 3, MAKE RELOCATION BINDING A FILTER, NOT A REVIEW STEP. claim.law.HV_permute-payload-check-does-not-bind-a-relocation-to-its-atom.20260901.v1 makes binding the deriving agent's obligation. Implemented as a hard rejection INSIDE the search loop - an order is discarded unless every relocated atom's (relocation type, symbol) matches the target object's relocation at its destination offset - it costs nothing and removes the failure mode entirely rather than deferring it to a human. It was load-bearing twice: dcsSampleAllocUpload's window carries two relocations both naming ch_info, and next_boss_hint/next_legend_hint's carry two both naming gPlayers. In both cases the two halves differ in TYPE so an exchange could not have slipped through undetected, but neither fact was knowable before the check ran.

WHAT THE CLOSURES LOOK LIKE, since the shape predicts the next ones: FIVE of the seven needed NO recolor stage whatsoever - permute plus one or two copy-form sites reproduced the target bytes exactly. HV's framing of the class as 'permute + recolor' with form as the near-miss understates it: the form stage is often the WHOLE remainder, and a function whose non-register cluster is a prologue full of zero seeds and address materializations is very likely to close with no register stage at all. All five form sites were in the direction equivalent_copy_form serves (ours the li, target the copy); the search enforces that structurally by rejecting any site whose target word does not decode as a register copy, which is the cheap way to honour the directionality the stage has.

MEASURED NON-MEMBERS, so they are not re-probed. next_rune_hint - the SIBLING of two functions that closed, and a caution against reasoning from source similarity - refuses at step 0 over all five windows tried with `breaks def-use chains: [(N,('g',5))]`, C1's recolor-induced-displacement class. DoEnemyAction refuses at step 0 AND is outside every existing edit class for a second reason worth naming: the target's load reads a DIFFERENT BASE REGISTER (r27 where ours reads r3, two registers holding equal values at that point), which is neither a form change nor a renaming. fn_800C37C4, fn_80051164 and init_all_dir_info admit no order (the last because the reorder changes the final write of `mem`). FontInit is not a postprocessor candidate at all - its non-register word is our `rlwinm r30,r27,2,0,29` against the target's `addi r30,r27,0`, a real arithmetic difference and therefore real source work; it is a good reminder that passing screens 1-3 means only that a search is WORTH running. debug_camera_pos reaches a consistent-recolor refusal at +0x9c on an FPR. towerRuneNearAudio, fn_8005FDA8 and CTriListCollide have 9-20 atom windows, beyond an exhaustive 8-atom search, and are the obvious next target for a smarter derivation than brute force.

ONE ROSTER CORRECTION for anyone working from the parent census: dcsSampleAllocUpload is in game/audio/dcs.c, not game/audio/dcsdrv. splits.txt gives dcs.c .text 0x800D1E04-0x800D4308 and the function sits at 0x800D374C; the graph's own symbol record already had it right. The error mattered for ownership screening, since lane DC held dcsdrv that run and did not in fact hold this function.
